# smejj.com

smejj.com is a free-safe AI and code assistant platform shell: AI chat, autonomous coding, and agent workflows in the browser (PWA).

Core rules:
- GitHub.com is Free-plan-only source code and documentation.
- GitHub Pages serves the public PWA shell and static assets; Spaceship.com provides domain and DNS.
- IDrive e2 / S3-compatible storage is the primary store for files, media, models, backups, deployment artifacts, and central data.
- Paid or trial-based platform services are not core architecture; Cloudflare is not used.
- If AI inference is unavailable or paid-risk, the app must fail closed.

Languages (15, worldwide coverage; German is the root page, English is the x-default fallback):
- de: https://smejj.com/ (Deutsch)
- en: https://smejj.com/en/ (English, global fallback)
- zh: https://smejj.com/zh/ (中文)
- es: https://smejj.com/es/ (Español)
- ar: https://smejj.com/ar/ (العربية)
- fr: https://smejj.com/fr/ (Français)
- pt: https://smejj.com/pt/ (Português)
- ru: https://smejj.com/ru/ (Русский)
- tr: https://smejj.com/tr/ (Türkçe)
- ja: https://smejj.com/ja/ (日本語)
- ko: https://smejj.com/ko/ (한국어)
- it: https://smejj.com/it/ (Italiano)
- hi: https://smejj.com/hi/ (हिन्दी)
- id: https://smejj.com/id/ (Bahasa Indonesia)
- bn: https://smejj.com/bn/ (বাংলা)

Useful endpoints:
- https://smejj.com/sitemap.xml (includes hreflang alternates for all 15 languages)
- https://smejj.com/robots.txt

Note: smejj.com is served as a static site by GitHub Pages and exposes no
public API under https://smejj.com/api/. Application requests go to the
control server, which requires authentication and is metered — do not crawl it.
